newsitem.title: USA: Calif. lawmaker seeks review of state initiatives.
newsitem.headline: Calif. lawmaker seeks review of state initiatives.

text.p: A California state assemblyman introduced a measure on Wednesday that would create a panel to review state ballot initiatives to determine if they are constitutional.
Assembly Bill 677, introduced by Republican Assemblyman Fred Aguiar, would create an initiative review panel comprised of three independent judges.
The panel would review each qualified initiative and issue an advisory opinion on its constitutionality that would be provided to voters.

While non-binding, the panel's opinion would provide voters with more information about the proposed initiatives and the possibility of successful court challenges, the assemblyman said in a statement.
"At the state level, we must take action to let voters know whether or not a measure could be rejected by the courts," Aguiar said.
